rules.title: Deterministic canonical projection
rules.requirement: The same proposal bundle bytes and supported schema generation MUST produce the same canonical projection and ordered task identities.

rules.title: Deterministic and contained discovery
rules.requirement: Project and proposal discovery MUST be deterministic, remain inside the selected project root, and reject unsafe paths.

rules.title: Managed transition boundary
rules.requirement: Approval, revision, task completion, archive, and abandonment MUST follow the allowed state transition and compare-and-swap inputs.

rules.title: Approval and attestation fail closed
rules.requirement: A missing, stale, or mismatched approval manifest, snapshot, task identity, or managed-state attestation MUST stop mutation.

rules.title: Atomic commit points
rules.requirement: Managed writes MUST preserve the documented commit point and MUST NOT expose a successful transition before its authoritative write commits.

rules.title: Evidence-backed safe retry
rules.requirement: A retry after partial failure MUST use operation evidence and current authoritative state, and MUST fail closed when idempotence cannot be proven.

rules.title: Archive bundle remains authoritative
rules.requirement: A committed terminal bundle MUST remain authoritative when derived INDEX maintenance fails, and INDEX MUST be reconstructable without inventing history.

rules.title: Explicit compatibility generations
rules.requirement: Supported legacy, Schema v1, and Schema v2 inputs MUST retain their documented behavior, while unknown future versions MUST fail closed before semantic use.

rules.title: Stable public CLI contract
rules.requirement: Public commands MUST preserve the versioned JSON envelope, stdout and stderr separation, exit classes, and stable error code and action semantics.

rules.title: Evidence-bounded diagnostics
rules.requirement: Doctor and validation diagnostics MUST report only observable evidence and MUST NOT infer or rewrite ambiguous history.

rules.title: Concurrent updates converge or fail stale
rules.requirement: Concurrent writers MUST either commit independent authoritative state safely or reject stale state without silently overwriting another operation.

rules.title: Agent adapter phase boundary
rules.requirement: The Skill adapter MUST preserve explicit phase triggers, approval gates, CLI-only managed mutation, and the separation between SDD state and source-control rollback.

rules.title: Portable validated package
rules.requirement: The installable Skill package MUST contain the declared runtime files, run on supported Python and operating-system generations, and exclude generated artifacts.

rules.title: Duplicated contract facts remain consistent
rules.requirement: Duplicated public version, command, runtime, and workflow facts MUST remain consistent with their canonical sources.

rules.title: Versioned conformance mapping
rules.requirement: Every executable reference-runtime test MUST map to at least one registered protocol rule, and every registered rule MUST have executable conformance evidence.
